Curious.text: It has stopped to inspect a tiny beetle on the path.
It is peeking into a flower to see who lives there.
It is watching a snail cross the ground.

Shy.text: It is pretending not to notice you looking at it.
It is hiding slightly behind its scarf.
It is peeking around a mushroom.

Startled.text: It just heard a strange noise in the bushes.
It nearly tripped over a tiny pebble.

Proud.text: It is showing off a shiny treasure it found.
It is posing like it just won a tiny parade.
It is standing very tall and waiting to be admired.

Sleepy.text: It is trying very hard not to fall asleep.
It is dozing in the sunshine.
It looks like it just woke up from a nap.

Zippy.text: It looks like it is about to dash off after something exciting.
It is bouncing in place and can barely stand still.
It just spotted a butterfly and is ready to chase it.

Nervous.text: It is unsure whether the little bug is a friend.
It is standing very still so nobody notices it.
It looks like it forgot why it came here.

Mischievous.text: It looks like it just stole a shiny button.
It is sneaking away from a tiny mess.
It knows something you do not know.

Grumpy.text: It does not approve of the weather.
It is annoyed that someone moved its favorite pebble.
It is glaring at a very cheerful flower.

Confused.text: It is trying to understand a mysterious footprint.
It is staring at something upside down.
It seems to have forgotten where it was going.

Daydreaming.text: It is imagining a tiny world inside a cloud.
It is listening to the wind like it is music.
It is staring at nothing in particular and enjoying it.

Bossy.text: It is giving important instructions to a tiny bug.
It is organizing a very small parade.
It is telling the flowers where to stand.
